# Packet — popol-vuh-022: The dancers before the lords; the death of Huncame and Vucub Came (fols. 30r–31v)

The established text (pinned) follows, one paragraph per block. A unit's `t` is cut from it by script (a sentence, or a long sentence or litany cut at a syntactic joint; couplets never split).

¶1
Xe opon puch cuꜭ ahauab, que mocho chic, chi qui xule la qui vach xe oponic; xqui quemelah quib, chi qui luc quib, chi qui pach quib; chi mayo quih, chi aꜩiac, quiꜩih vi chi meba qui vachibal xe oponic.

¶2
Ta xꜩonox cut qui huyubal, camac puch; xꜩonox nai puch qui chuch, qui cahau. “Apa quix pe vi?” xe vꜭhaxic. “Maba quetaon, at ahau. Maui xquetamah v vach ca chuch, ca cahau; ca oh chutic oc ta xe camic,” xa xeꜭha; maui naquila xqui biyh.

¶3
“Vꜩ bala. Chi ban ta ba ca cay; naqui chivah? Yvahil chi ca yao,” xe vꜭhaxic. “Maba ca cah; quiꜩih chi ca ca xibih quib,” xeꜭha chic chire ahau. “Mi xibih ivib, mix xobic; quix xahon oc. Are ta nabe chi xah ri quix puzu ta ivib; chi poroh ta curi vochoch; chi bana ronohel ri ivetaam. Coh cay tah, ca cah are vma ca ꜭux. Quix be tac oc rumal, ix meba; chi ca ya yvahil,” xe vꜭhax cut.

¶4
Ta xqui tiquiba cut qui bix, qui xahoh; ta xul cut ronohel ri Xibalba, xe pulic e cayel ronohel. Cut xqui xaho; xqui xah Cux, xqui xah Puhuy, xqui xah Yboy.

¶5
Xꜭha cu ahau chique: “Chi puzu ri nu ꜩy; chi caztah chi v vach ivumal,” xe vꜭhaxic. “Ve,” xeꜭha. Ta xqui puz ꜩy, xꜭaztai chi v vach; quiꜩih cu chi quicot ri ꜩy ta xꜭaztah v vach, chu zacbizala vhe ta xꜭaztah v vach.

¶6
Xꜭha cu ahau chique: “Chi poroh na ba vochoch,” xe vꜭhaxic chic. Ta xqui poroh cut rochoch ahau, e pulinac ahauab pa ha conohel; maui xecahic. Libah chi chic xcuꜩinizah; mana huzu zachic ri rochoch Huncame.

¶7
Xqui maihah cut conohel ahauab; xavi cu xere que xahouic, nim que quicotic. Xe vꜭhax chi cut rumal ahau: “Chi camizah na cu hun vinac, chi puzu, ma ta cu chi camic,” xe vꜭhax cut.

¶8
“Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha. Ta xqui chap cut hun vinac; cate xqui puzu, xqui poꜫoh cu acanoc vꜭux ri hun vinac; xqui coloba cut chi qui vach ahauab. Xqui maiha chi cut Huncame, Vvcub Came; libah chi cut xꜭazta chi v vach ri hun vinac cumal; nim chi quicot vꜭux ta xꜭaztah v vach.

¶9
Xqui maihah cut ahauab: “Chi puzu chi na cu ivib, chi quil tah; quiꜩih cu raih ca ꜭux ri i xahoh,” xeꜭha chi cu ahauab. “Vꜩ bala, at ahau,” xeꜭha cut.

¶10
Cate puch xqui puz quib. Are cu xpuz ri Xhunahpu rumal Xbalanque; huhunal cu xperepoxic racan vcab, xel vholom, xcole aponoc chi nah; xcotix vloc vꜭux, xcheque chuvach ꜩalic, que cabar curi ronohel rahaual Xibalba. Chi cay xa cu hun chi ca xahouilabic ri Xbalanque. “Ca valih oc!” xꜭha cut. Libah chi cut xꜭaztah v vach. Nim que quicotic. Xavi quehe que quicot ahauab; xavi are que banouic ca quicot qui ꜭux Huncame, Vvcub Came, queheri are que xahouic ca qui nao.

¶11
Cate puch v rainic, v malinic pu qui ꜭux ahauab chire qui xahoh Xhunahpu, Xbalanque, ta xel cu qui ꜩih Huncame, Vvcub Came: “Chi bana chique; coh i puzu,” xeꜭha cut. “Hunal tah coh i puzu,” xecha cut Huncame, Vvcub Came chique ri Xhunahpu, Xbalanque.

¶12
“Vꜩ bala; chi ꜭaztah i vach. Ma pa ix ꜭo cam? Oh pu quicotirizai ive, ix pu rahaual ival i ꜭahol,” xeꜭha cut chique ahauab.

¶13
Are cu nabe xpuz ri qui vholom ahau, Huncame vbi, rahaual Xibalba. Caminac chi cut Huncame, ta xchap chic Vvcub Came; maui xꜭaztah chi qui vach.

¶14
Cate pu quelic Xibalba chi cacan, are xquil ri ahauab xe camic, e xaraxoh chubic, e pu xaraxoxinac qui cabichal; xa cu cahizabal qui vach xbanic. Huzuc xucamibeh ri hun ahau; mana xqui ꜭaztah chi v vach.

¶15
Are cu ri hun ahau xelah na, xoc na chi qui vach ri e xahol; maui xuculu, ma pu xurico. “Tocob nu vach,” xꜭha, ta xu na rib.

¶16
Xe quiz cu bec ronohel cal qui ꜭahol pa nima zivan; xa hun xqui balih vi quib pa nima xolobachan. Chiri cut e tubul vi, ta xe culun cut; maui ahilan chi zanic hucaly vla que pa zivan. Queheri xe beyox vloc, ta xe ul cut, xqui xul qui ya chi quib conohel; xe ul elahoc, xe ul pu ococ. Quehe cut que chacatahic rahaual Xibalba, xa maihabal, xa pu qui halvachibal quib ta xqui bano.

## Establishment log (doubtful readings, letters chosen, supralinear words — the notes must say so)

# Establishment log — popol-vuh-022 (image 0069 from line 20, 0070, 0071, 0072 lines 1–2)

Read 2026-11-28 by the routine's own model from source/pages/i0069 (from the indented `Xe opon puch cuꜭ ahauab`, after
`… camol que ta xebec cut ruꜭ ahau.`), all of i0070 and i0071, and i0072 to `… ta xqui bano.` (its second line), in
strips of about six lines at full resolution, with 1.5–1.8× crops of doubtful words, checked word by word against
Brasseur 1861 (OCR lines c. 26994–27300, the rest of his chapter 13). Pillow in a scratch venv.

Start: `Xe opon puch cuꜭ ahauab` (0069, indented). End: `… xa pu qui halvachibal quib ta xqui bano.` (0072 l.2), the end
of Brasseur's chapter 13. The next words, `Cate puch ta xqui biyh qui bi, xqui cobizah quib …` (0072 l.2), begin his
chapter 14 and popol-vuh-023 (the indented `Chitaa ca bi` follows on l.5). parts.json: 023 images set to 0072–0074
(was 0075–0077, which would have left 0072–0074 unread); plan.md row updated.

Content: the ragged dancers come before the lords, bowing low; asked their mountain, people, mother and father, they say
they never knew them; the lords offer payment for a show; they dance the Cux, Puhuy and Yboy; they kill the lord's dog
and bring it back to life (it wags its tail); they burn the lord's house with the lords inside and restore it; they
sacrifice a man, hold up his heart, and revive him; asked to sacrifice themselves, Xbalanque dismembers Hunahpu and
calls him back ("Ca valih oc!"); Huncame and Vucub Came ask to be sacrificed; Huncame is killed and not revived, then
Vucub Came; the other lords flee and are killed; one lord humbles himself; their sons and vassals scatter into a great
canyon, and come back to give themselves up; so the lords of Xibalba were defeated.

Paragraphs: Ximénez's indents at `Xe opon puch` (0069) and `Cate puch v rainic` (0071); the others are ours at the sense
joints, following Brasseur's breaks, as 015–021.

## Folios
0070 carries `30` at the top left (30v), 0072 `31` (31v); so 0069 = 30r, 0071 = 31r → `fols. 30r–31v`.

## The cuatrillo in `ꜭaztah` 'come back to life'
The word is written seven times with a q/g-shaped letter before `a` (0070 `xꜭaztai`, `xꜭaztah` ×2, `xꜭazta`, `xꜭaztah`;
0071 `xꜭaztah` ×2, `chi ꜭaztah`, `xqui ꜭaztah`) and once with a plain c (0070 l.5 `chi caztah`). A q-shape before
`a` cannot be Ximénez's qu for /k/, so it is the cuatrillo; Brasseur `qaztah` agrees. Printed ꜭ where the hand has the
g-shape and c where it has c (published parts have both `caztah` and `ꜭaztah`).

## Letters and readings decided against or beside Brasseur
- 0069 `chi qui pach quib`: in the MS; Brasseur omits it.
- 0069 `chi mayo quih`: q-shaped letter; Brasseur `mayo gih` (ꜫ). Printed quih as written; meaning uncertain. Doubtful.
- 0069 `chi aꜩiac` (MS `chiaꜩiac`): Brasseur `atziyak`; as 021's aꜩiyac/aꜩiiac.
- 0069 `qui vachibal`: Brasseur's OCR garbled here (`qui Кра!`).
- 0069 `camac puch`: MS plain c; Brasseur `camag` (ꜫ).
- 0069 `xe vꜭhaxic` (MS `xeughaxic`, four times on 0069–0070) and `xe vꜭhax`: as published.
- 0069 `quetaon`: a mark over the end of the word (abbreviation?); Brasseur `k'etaon`. Printed as written.
- 0069 `naqui chivah? Yvahil`: MS `naquichivah yvahil`; Brasseur `naki ch'yv'ahi, yv'ahil`. Division ours; `yvahil`
  with the y the MS writes (it writes `ivib`, `ivetaam`, `ivumal` with i). Doubtful division.
- 0069 `mix xobic`: MS `mixxobic`; Brasseur `m yx xobic`.
- 0069 `chi xah`: MS `chixah`; Brasseur `ch'y xah`.
- 0069 `coh cay tah, ca cah are vma ca ꜭux`: MS `coh caytah cacah arevmaca qux`; Brasseur `koh cay-tah, ça cah are uma
  ka qux`. `vma` doubtful (meaning unclear).
- 0069 `quix be tac oc`: MS `quixbetacoc`; Brasseur `qu yx be-tak-oc`.
- 0070 `ꜩy` 'dog' (three times): the MS writes `ꜩy`, with a small mark over the y; published parts print `ꜩi`. Printed as
  written; the drafter should treat it as the same word. Brasseur `tzi`.
- 0070 `xꜭaztai`: the last letter is i with an accent stroke, not h; Brasseur `x-qaztal`. Doubtful ending.
- 0070 `chu zacbizala vhe`: Brasseur `ch'u zakbizala u he`.
- 0070 `xcuꜩinizah`: MS plain c; Brasseur `x-c'utzinizah`.
- 0070 l.~19 `xqui poꜫoh`: the 3-shaped tresillo; Brasseur `pogoh` (g = ꜫ).
- 0070 `Chi puzu chi na cu ivib`: the MS has `chi puzu na` with the `na` blotted out (struck), then `chi na cu ivib`.
  The struck word is left out.
- 0070 `ri i xahoh`: MS `ri ixahoh`; Brasseur `ri y xahoh`.
- 0070 `xeꜭha chi cu ahauab`: MS `xegha chicu`; Brasseur `x-e cha chicu`. Division doubtful (`chic u`?).
- 0070 `ri Xhunahpu` (and on 0071 twice): the MS writes Xhunahpu here, as Brasseur; elsewhere Hunahpu.
- 0070 `xcotix`: the MS letter after `co` is the h-like t (as 021 `ꜩiꜩohic`), with an i; Brasseur `x-qotix`. Read t. Doubtful.
- 0070 `chuvach ꜩalic`: the looped tz ligature; Brasseur `tzalic`.
- 0070–0071 `Ca valih oc`: MS `cava-|lihoc`; division as Brasseur `Ca valih-oc`.
- 0071 `xecha cut` (after `Hunal tah coh i puzu`): written with plain ch, not the ꜭh of `xegha` two lines above; printed
  as written. The words `xeꜭha cut. “Hunal tah coh i puzu,”` are in the MS and missing from Brasseur.
- 0071 `Chi bana chique; coh i puzu`: MS `chibana chique coh ipuzu`; Brasseur `Ch'y bana che, koh y puzo`. `chique`
  as written (sense 'do it [so] to us'?). Doubtful.
- 0071 `quicotirizai`: the t is h-shaped; Brasseur `quicotirizay`.
- 0071 `ival i ꜭahol`: MS `ivaliqahol` (q-shape before a → ꜭ); Brasseur `yv'al, y qahol`.
- 0071 `ri qui vholom ahau`: Brasseur `ri qui u holom ahau`.
- 0071 `quelic`: MS `quelic`; Brasseur `x-elic`. Printed as written (que + elic?). Doubtful.
- 0071 `chi cacan` (MS `chica-|can`): Brasseur `chi c'akan`.
- 0071 `Tocob`: MS plain c; Brasseur `Togob`.
- 0071 `Xe quiz`: z-shaped letter (not the looped ꜩ); Brasseur `X-e quiz`.
- 0071 `ta xe culun cut`: MS clear; Brasseur `ta x-qutun cut`.
- 0071 `chi zanic hucaly vla`: MS `chiʒanic hucaly̆ vla`, a mark over the y; Brasseur `chi Zii tuculiy ula` (OCR damaged).
  The first letter is h-shaped (Ximénez's t often is); printed h as the hand. Doubtful word.
- 0071 `xe ul elahoc`: the last letter is blotted (k-like); read c with Brasseur `elah-oc`.
- 0071 `que chacatahic`: MS `quechacatahic`, a mark over the e; Brasseur `qui chakatahic`.
